summary: BKV Corp filed an 8-K to disclose a Sixth Amendment to its RBL Credit Agreement, solely modifying certain financial covenants (net leverage ratios) to permit more flexibility for restricted payments, debt prepayments, and investments. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is involved. The amendment adjusts leverage ratios upward by 0.25x, easing constraints on capital allocation. There is no transaction, recommendation, or structural event beyond a routine credit agreement amendment. This is a financing covenant change, not a special situation; thus no deal terms apply.
